assertions.name: three_body_dominates_the_irreducible_four_body_alpha_unit
assertions.source: cluster expansion of 4He from AME2020 alone: 2-body 8.8982648, 3-body 14.603145, 4-body 4.7942522 MeV, ratio 3.04597. The 2-body input is pn only, because the diproton and dineutron are UNBOUND (1S0 virtual states) -- an empirical fact about nature, not a framework quantity. So the corpus's '~21 MeV 4-body alpha unit' is a PAIRWISE-CHAIN residual lumping all orders >= 3, not a four-body term.

assertions.name: jet_unit_weight_profile_is_monotone_while_the_empirical_one_peaks_at_n3
assertions.source: jet unit-weight per-order terms m_e·a_D^(n) = 0.51099895, 0.6832056, 1.2942581 (increasing) against the empirical 8.89826, 14.6031, 4.79425 (peaked at n = 3). A monotone profile cannot reproduce a peak, so the whole shape must come from the undetermined weight w_n.

assertions.name: weight_ratio_w4_over_w3_is_bounded_below_one_half
assertions.source: to put the peak at n = 3 the jet tower needs a_D^(4)·w_4 < a_D^(3)·w_3, i.e. w_4/w_3 < a_D^(3)/a_D^(4) = 0.52787429; to reproduce the empirical ratio exactly, w_4/w_3 = 0.17330256. Unfitted: both sides come from AME plus the corpus's own a_D, with no free parameter.

assertions.name: gb_grade_and_h_power_parity_lock_holds_on_the_corpus_certificate
assertions.source: from the reduction rule, g = 2a + b − L so b ≡ g + L (mod 2). Checked against gb-filtration-jet-order.witness.json for σ₁³ ∈ H₂ (L = 3): grade 1 carries q²−1+q⁻² = h²+1, h-powers {0,2} even, g+L = 4 even; grade 0 carries h, h-power 1 odd, g+L = 3 odd. This is what ties the ℏ_q expansion of bean qou-zrx2 to the GB filtration: at q = 1, h = 0, every descending term dies, H_n(q) → ℂ[S_n], and the trace is a permutation character — which is the derived classical floor c₀(A).

description: Re-derives the '~21 MeV 4-body alpha-residual' through the GB filtration and the jet body-order tower. With the empirically correct 2-body input (pn only -- the diproton and dineutron are unbound) the cluster expansion of 4He is 8.90 two-body, 14.60 THREE-body, 4.79 four-body: the residual is not mostly 4-body, and 3-body dominates by 3.05x. Yields an unfitted constraint on the open jet weight w_n.

cluster_expansion_of_4He.two_body_input: b2(pn) = 2.22456637 (deuteron, 3S1). b2(pp) = b2(nn) = 0: the diproton and dineutron are UNBOUND, 1S0 virtual states, a_pp ~ -17.3 fm (Coulomb-corrected), a_nn ~ -18.7 fm, against a_np(1S0) ~ -23.7 fm.
cluster_expansion_of_4He.consequence: the corpus's '~21 MeV irreducible 4-body alpha unit' is the PAIRWISE-CHAIN residual, which lumps every order >= 3 together AND credits pp/nn bonds that nature does not bind. The genuine four-body term is 4.79 MeV.

jet_tower.formula: B(K) = sum_{n=2}^{A} m_e * a_D^(n) * w_n(K),  a_D^(n) = lw(n-1) = (1/n) sum_{lambda |- n} dim_q V_lambda

derived_constraint_on_w.reading: any candidate residue weight that is flat or rising in n is excluded before evaluation; it must fall by at least 1.9x from n=3 to n=4, and by 5.8x to reproduce 4He.

gb_filtration.reduction_rule: T_w T_i = T_{w s_i} if ascending; h T_w + T_{w s_i} if descending, h = q - 1/q
gb_filtration.parity_lock: g = 2a + b - L, so b = h-power satisfies b = g + L (mod 2)
gb_filtration.classical_limit: at q = 1, h = 0: H_n(q) -> C[S_n], the trace becomes a permutation character, and the derived floor c0(A) = 2^-A - 2^(1-2A) of bean qou-zrx2 is exactly the top-grade associated graded. The hbar_q expansion IS this filtration read by grade.
gb_filtration.collapse_class_status: GBFiltrationCollapsesAtE2 was made a `def` rather than an `instance` on 2026-08-24 (bean qou-fngs), so it no longer discharges itself for every R. Downstream theorems taking it are genuinely conditional. Verified in QOU/Mathlib/SpectralSequence.lean.

standard_model_and_eightfold_way.eightfold_way: NOTHING. Flavour SU(3) classifies hadrons and constrains their masses (Gell-Mann-Okubo). Nuclear binding is the residual colour force between colour-singlet nucleons -- a different regime. There is no eightfold-way statement about B(4He) and the corpus should not expect one.
standard_model_and_eightfold_way.standard_model: In principle QCD fixes B(4He); in practice there is no first-principles closed form. Lattice QCD binds light nuclei at unphysically heavy pion masses and is at the edge of feasibility at the physical point. Chiral EFT reproduces A <= 4 only WITH three-nucleon forces whose LECs are fitted; NN-only underbinds 4He by several MeV (the Tjon line is the 3H-4He diagnostic).
standard_model_and_eightfold_way.semf_caveat: the liquid-drop formula is fitted for A >~ 20; A = 4 is outside its domain. Quoted as context for how badly the collective picture does at the alpha, NOT as a test.
standard_model_and_eightfold_way.what_the_corpus_can_be_held_to: not reproducing a number nobody derives, but the SHAPE: a body-order profile peaking at n = 3. That is a check the jet tower currently fails at unit weight, and which the w_4/w_3 constraint turns into a target.

data.what_neither_filtration_can_inform_about: The alpha-unit's categorical representation, structurally rather than for want of work. a_D^(n) = (1/n) sum_{lambda |- n} dim_q V_lambda depends ONLY on n -- an average over all partitions, carrying no flavour, no knot type, no linking data, so it cannot distinguish 4He from any other four-body cluster. The GB filtration grades a WORD by Coxeter length, and its q -> 1 associated graded is a permutation character whose floor c0(A) depends only on A (3H and 3He agree exactly; so do 5Li and 5He). Every isotope-specific and alpha-specific fact therefore lives entirely in w_n(K), the undetermined factor. The filtrations organise the expansion; they do not populate it. Concretely: 4He is doubly magic with a first excited state at 20.21 MeV, and neither a_D nor the GB grade has a variable that could express that.
data.verdict: The '~21 MeV 4-body alpha-residual' is misnamed. With the empirically correct two-body input -- pn only, since the diproton and dineutron are unbound -- the cluster expansion of 4He is 8.90 two-body, 14.60 THREE-body, 4.79 four-body, with 3-body dominating 4-body by 3.05x. The corpus's figure is a pairwise-chain residual lumping all orders >= 3 and crediting pp/nn bonds nature does not bind. The genuine irreducible alpha unit is ~4.8 MeV. This yields an unfitted constraint on the open jet weight: w_4/w_3 < 0.5279 to peak at n = 3, and = 0.1733 to match 4He. Neither filtration can supply the alpha-unit's categorical representation: a_D depends only on n and the GB floor only on A, so all knot-specific content sits in w_n(K).
